title: Brain Leech
description:
[jitter]*thunk*[/jitter]

A sharp pain is felt atop your head and a thought stabs into your mind.

[purple][sine]"SHARE KNOWLEDGE???"[/sine][/purple]

You are unsure how to proceed...

options.title: Share Knowledge
options.description: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]5[/blue] random cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

options.title: Rip the Leech Off
options.description: Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Gain a Colorless card reward.

notes: The creature prompts you with a psychic question. Choosing [gold]Share Knowledge[/gold] allows the creature to feed on your knowledge, resulting in a new card being added to your deck. Choosing [gold]Rip the Leech Off[/gold] results in violent rejection, dealing [red]5[/red] HP damage but offering a Colorless card as compensation. Both choices conclude the event with different flavor text.
